en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large institutional complex in a rural setting. The central building is a multi‑storey, symmetrical structure with a small tower or cupola and wings extending on both sides, flanked by several wooden houses. There is open grassland in the foreground and forest in the background. Printed captions appear at the bottom indicating the name of the place and the publisher.
